papers:

  # === Category 1: Reward Diversity / Reward Shaping for RL Stability ===

  - title: "GDPO: Group reward-Decoupled Normalization Policy Optimization for Multi-reward RL Optimization"
    authors: NVIDIA Labs
    year: 2025
    venue: ICML 2026
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.05242
    category: reward_diversity
    role: closest_prior_work
    key_finding: >
      直接将 GRPO 应用于多 reward 组合时，不同 rollout 的 reward 组合在归一化后 collapse 为相同 advantage 值，
      降低训练信号分辨率导致收敛失败。GDPO 对每个 reward 独立做 group-wise normalization 再聚合，
      保留多 reward 的相对差异，显著提升训练稳定性。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      最直接相关。CED reward 本质上引入了独立于 extraction F1 的 reward 维度（evidence quality），
      GDPO 的理论分析解释了为什么多维 reward 比单一 reward 更稳定——独立 reward 维度防止 advantage collapse。
      但 GDPO 是方法论贡献，CED 是 task-specific reward 设计自然具备了这一特性。

  - title: "DRA-GRPO: Exploring Diversity-Aware Reward Adjustment for R1-Zero-Like Training of LLMs"
    authors: Xiwen Chen et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2505.09655
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.09655
    category: reward_diversity
    role: related_method
    key_finding: >
      GRPO 的标量 reward 无法区分语义多样但得分相同的输出（diversity-quality inconsistency）。
      DRA 用子模互信息（SMI）对 reward 加权，给多样性高的 completion 更大权重，
      等价于 Inverse Propensity Scoring 去偏，防止 policy 坍缩到先验模式。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      DRA 通过后处理 reward 注入多样性信号；CED 的 reward 本身就内含对比结构自然提供 diversity 信号。
      机制互补但来源不同——CED 是 reward design 层面，DRA 是 optimization 层面。

  - title: "Shrinking the Variance: Shrinkage Baselines for RL with Verifiable Rewards"
    authors: Guanning Zeng et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2511.03710
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.03710
    category: reward_diversity
    role: theoretical_support
    key_finding: >
      RLVR 中 per-prompt 均值 baseline 在低 generation 数下估计不准导致高 variance 梯度。
      用 James-Stein shrinkage 混合 per-prompt 和 cross-prompt 均值，
      构造可证明更低 variance 的 policy gradient estimator。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      理论支持：reward variance 对 gradient estimation 质量至关重要。
      CED 的额外 reward 维度提供更丰富的 per-group variance，间接起到 variance 维持效果。

  - title: "Reward Shaping to Mitigate Reward Hacking in RLHF"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2502.18770
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.18770
    category: reward_diversity
    role: background
    key_finding: >
      RL reward 应有界且先快速增长后缓慢收敛。系统研究 reward shaping 原则，
      好的 reward 形状能抑制 reward hacking 并提升训练稳定性。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      CED reward 的 0-1 对比判别结构天然满足有界性，
      且 evidence quality 的渐进提升符合"先快后慢"的 reward shaping 原则。

  # === Category 2: Mode Collapse Prevention in GRPO/RLHF ===

  - title: "DAPO: An Open-Source LLM Reinforcement Learning System at Scale"
    authors: ByteDance Seed, Tsinghua AIR
    year: 2025
    venue: NeurIPS 2025
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.14476
    category: mode_collapse_prevention
    role: key_baseline
    key_finding: >
      Naive GRPO 存在 entropy collapse（policy 熵快速下降→输出同质化）。
      根因：clipping 不对称性——概率 0.01 的 token 最多增到 0.012，而概率 0.9 的 token 可达 1.08，
      低概率 token 难以增长，抑制探索。DAPO 提出 Clip-Higher（εhigh=0.28 > εlow=0.2）
      为低概率 token 留更大增长空间，加 Dynamic Sampling 过滤 accuracy=0 或 1 的 prompt
      （这些 prompt 产生零梯度，降低有效 batch size）。在 AIME 2024 达 50 分超越 DeepSeek-R1-Zero。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      DAPO 从 optimization 技巧角度解决 entropy collapse。CED reward 从 reward design 层面
      防止 mode collapse——evidence quality 维度确保 reward 组内有足够 variance，
      不会出现 all-same-reward 的零梯度 prompt。DAPO 的 Dynamic Sampling 过滤 accuracy=0/1 prompt
      与我们观察到的 frac_zero_std→0.8 现象本质相同：extraction-only reward 下大量 prompt
      产生零 advantage，CED 从源头（reward 设计）而非后处理（过滤）解决这个问题。

  - title: "Dr. GRPO: Removing Optimization Bias in GRPO"
    authors: Liu et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: COLM 2025
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.20783
    category: mode_collapse_prevention
    role: related_analysis
    key_finding: >
      GRPO 的 std 归一化引入两个 bias：(1) difficulty bias——std(r) 归一化对低 variance 组
      （全对/全错）给予过高 advantage 权重，trivial question 主导训练信号；
      (2) length bias——per-token loss 的 1/|o_i| 项使长的错误回答被 under-penalize。
      当 std(r)→0 时 advantage 爆炸或未定义，梯度数值不稳定。
      Dr. GRPO 移除 std 归一化，用无偏 Monte Carlo advantage：Ã = R(q,o_i) - mean(R)。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      与我们的实验发现高度一致：extraction-only reward 下 frac_zero_std→0.8 正是
      Dr. GRPO 分析的 difficulty bias 极端情况——大量 prompt 的所有 rollout 得到相同 F1，
      std→0 导致 advantage 异常。CED 通过增加 reward 维度天然维持 reward_std>0，
      从 reward 设计而非算法修改角度避免了 Dr. GRPO 发现的 bias。

  - title: "GVPO: Group Variance Policy Optimization for LLM Post-Training"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025
    venue: NeurIPS 2025
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.19599
    category: mode_collapse_prevention
    role: alternative_framework
    key_finding: >
      将 KL 约束 reward 最大化的解析解直接嵌入梯度权重，
      variance 项自然平衡 exploration 与 exploitation，维持适度 entropy。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      GVPO 的 variance 项机制与 CED 维持 reward variance 的效果功能类似，
      但 GVPO 是算法层面 implicit regularization，CED 是 reward 层面 explicit structure。

  - title: "REINFORCE++: Stabilizing Critic-Free Policy Optimization with Global Advantage Normalization"
    authors: Jian Hu et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2501.03262
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.03262
    category: mode_collapse_prevention
    role: related_method
    key_finding: >
      Prompt-level (local) advantage normalization 导致不准确估计和过拟合。
      Global batch normalization 提供更稳定、理论无偏的 gradient estimator。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      解决 local normalization 的 variance 问题；CED 从 reward 端增加 variance 来源。
      两者在不同层面解决同一问题：防止 gradient signal 消失。

  - title: "DiverseGRPO: Mitigating Mode Collapse in Image Generation via Diversity-Aware GRPO"
    authors: Henglin Liu et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2512.21514
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.21514
    category: mode_collapse_prevention
    role: parallel_work
    key_finding: >
      图像生成中 GRPO 后期输出同质化。distributional reward modeling（谱聚类+exploratory reward）
      和 structure-aware regularization 实现 13-18% 语义多样性提升。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      跨域验证了 GRPO mode collapse 的普遍性，distributional reward 思路与 CED 精神相近——
      都是通过 reward 层面结构化信号维持输出多样性。

  - title: "Why GRPO Needs Normalization: A Local-Curvature Perspective on Adaptive Gradients"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2601.23135
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.23135
    category: mode_collapse_prevention
    role: theoretical_support
    key_finding: >
      GRPO 的 reward_std 归一化在温和条件下提供严格优于未归一化 REINFORCE 的收敛速率，
      收益由 prompt 间平均 reward std 刻画。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      直接理论支撑：reward_std 越大收敛越好。CED 通过 evidence quality 维度维持高 reward_std，
      从该理论看 CED 的稳定性优势是 reward_std 维持带来的收敛速率优势。

  # === Category 3: Contrastive Rewards in RL ===

  - title: "Improving Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback Using Contrastive Rewards"
    authors: Shen, Zhang et al.
    year: 2024
    venue: arXiv 2403.07708
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.07708
    category: contrastive_reward
    role: closest_contrastive_precedent
    key_finding: >
      两步机制：(1) 离线采样 baseline response；(2) 用 baseline 计算 contrastive reward
      作为 PPO 的 penalty 项。效果：惩罚 reward uncertainty、根据任务难度自适应校准、
      减少 PPO 中的 variance。在 TL;DR 和 HH-RLHF 上持续优于标准 RLHF。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      最接近的对比 reward 先例。关键差异：(1) 它是对 learned RM 输出的后处理对比，
      CED 是 reward function 本身就是对比判别（evidence vs. corrupted evidence）；
      (2) 它在 PPO 中验证，CED 在 GRPO 中验证；
      (3) 它是 domain-agnostic penalty，CED 是 task-specific faithfulness signal。
      stabilizing 机制相通但实现路径根本不同。

  - title: "Improving Discriminative Capability of Reward Models in RLHF Using Contrastive Learning"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2024
    venue: EMNLP 2024
    url: https://aclanthology.org/2024.emnlp-main.852/
    category: contrastive_reward
    role: related_method
    key_finding: >
      无监督对比损失训练 reward model 充分捕捉对比数据区分度，
      带来更稳定的 PPO 训练 return 和 reward。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      验证对比训练 reward model → 更稳定 RL 训练链条。CED 不是对比训练 reward model，
      而是 reward function 本身就是对比判别，但 stabilizing 机制相通。

  - title: "Contrastive Preference Learning: Learning from Human Feedback without RL"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2024
    venue: ICLR 2025
    url: https://openreview.net/forum?id=iX1RjVQODj
    category: contrastive_reward
    role: background
    key_finding: >
      将 preference learning 重新表述为对比学习问题，无需显式 RL 即可从人类反馈中学习。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      对比框架在 preference alignment 中的通用性。CED 可被视为 task-specific contrastive preference signal。

  # === Category 4: Evidence-Based Rewards in IE/NLP ===

  - title: "Drift: Enhancing LLM Faithfulness in Rationale Generation"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025
    venue: ACL 2025
    url: https://aclanthology.org/2025.acl-long.340.pdf
    category: evidence_reward
    role: related_method
    key_finding: >
      用 faithfulness reward 引导 LLM 生成更可靠的 rationale，提升 CoT 推理事实一致性。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      Faithfulness reward 用于生成质量的先例。CED 中 evidence discrimination
      本质上也是 faithfulness 信号——判断证据是否忠实支持抽取结果。

  - title: "Fine-Grained NLI-Based Faithfulness Evaluation for Diverse Summarisation Tasks (INFUSE)"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2024
    venue: EACL 2024
    url: https://aclanthology.org/2024.eacl-long.102/
    category: evidence_reward
    role: background
    key_finding: >
      变长前提+简化假设的细粒度 NLI faithfulness 评估，超越传统 NLI 在多任务摘要上的表现。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      NLI 作为 faithfulness 评估工具的进展。CED 中 NLI 组件用于判断 evidence 对 triple 的支持度。

  - title: "Enhancing Cross-Evidence Reasoning Graph for Document-Level Relation Extraction"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2024
    venue: PMC/Bioinformatics 2024
    url: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11232587/
    category: evidence_reward
    role: background
    key_finding: >
      文档级关系抽取中用 cross-evidence reasoning graph 增强跨证据推理。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      DocRE 中 evidence 的重要性。但用 evidence 作为模型输入特征，
      我们用 evidence quality 作为 RL reward 信号——定位根本不同。

  # === Category 5: Multi-Objective RL for Text Generation ===

  - title: "Confronting Reward Model Overoptimization with Constrained RLHF"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025
    venue: OpenReview
    url: https://openreview.net/forum?id=gkfUvn0fLU
    category: multi_objective_rl
    role: related_analysis
    key_finding: >
      多组件 RM 的 overoptimization 研究。component RM 间的相关性显著影响 overoptimization 临界点，
      用 constrained MDP 防止超出适当边界。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      CED 引入了与 extraction F1 低相关的 reward component（evidence quality），
      根据该论文分析低相关多组件 reward 更不易 overoptimize，
      可能是 CED 稳定性的另一个理论解释角度。

  - title: "On-Policy RL with Optimal Reward Baseline"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2505.23585
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.23585
    category: multi_objective_rl
    role: theoretical_support
    key_finding: >
      Optimal baseline 一致性地实现更高训练 reward 和更高 entropy，
      有效稳定训练并促进更多样的 policy exploration。
    relevance_to_ced_stabilizer: >
      CED reward 的多维特性可能起到类似 optimal baseline 效果——
      evidence quality 维度为 advantage estimation 提供更丰富的参照信号。

  # === Category 6: RSFT Methodology & Theory ===

  - title: "A Minimalist Approach to LLM Reasoning: from Rejection Sampling to Reinforce"
    authors: Xiao et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2504.11343
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.11343
    category: rsft_methodology
    role: key_theoretical_support
    key_finding: >
      RAFT（简单 rejection sampling baseline）在数学推理上与 GRPO/PPO 表现相当。
      消融实验表明 GRPO 的主要优势来自丢弃全错 prompt 而非 reward normalization。
      提出 Reinforce-Rej，在 RAFT 基础上过滤全对和全错 sample。
      关键洞察：GRPO 和 RAFT 的核心区别在于负样本处理——GRPO 混合正负样本训练，
      RAFT 只用正样本，但 RAFT 仍能达到相当性能，说明 rejection sampling 的简单性被低估了。
    relevance_to_rsft_docre: >
      直接支持我们的设计选择：(1) RSFT 在 DocRE 上成功而 GRPO 失败，
      与该论文发现一致——rejection sampling 的 offline 特性天然避免了 catastrophic forgetting；
      (2) GRPO 主要优势来自过滤全错 prompt，这与我们 RSFT 的 reward-based filtering 机制相同；
      (3) DocRE structured output 比 math reasoning 更难用 online RL 优化，
      强化了 offline RSFT 的合理性。

  - title: "Beyond Rejection Sampling: Trajectory Fusion for Scaling Mathematical Reasoning (TrajFusion)"
    authors: Jie Deng et al.
    year: 2026
    venue: arXiv 2602.04391
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.04391
    category: rsft_methodology
    role: method_component
    key_finding: >
      传统 RSFT 只用正确轨迹，丢弃错误轨迹。TrajFusion 将错误和正确轨迹交替拼接，
      显式建模试错推理过程，在困难数学问题上显著超越标准 RFT。
    relevance_to_rsft_docre: >
      Future work 方向：可考虑在 DocRE RSFT 中融合失败样本的信息。
      但 DocRE 的结构化输出（JSON triple）不同于 math 的 chain-of-thought，
      融合方式需要重新设计。

  - title: "Rejection Sampling Based Fine Tuning Secretly Performs PPO"
    authors: Anonymous
    year: 2025
    venue: ICML 2025
    url: https://openreview.net/forum?id=yQ2UivKlir
    category: rsft_methodology
    role: theoretical_support
    key_finding: >
      建立 RSFT 与 PPO 之间的理论联系：rejection sampling fine-tuning
      在特定条件下隐式执行 PPO with marginal KL constraints。
    relevance_to_rsft_docre: >
      为 RSFT 的有效性提供理论解释。我们的 RSFT 成功可被视为
      隐式执行了 constrained policy optimization，
      避免了显式 GRPO 在 structured output 上的不稳定性。

  # === Category 7: RL for Information Extraction ===

  - title: "R1-RE: Cross-Domain Relation Extraction with RLVR"
    authors: Runpeng Dai, Tong Zheng et al.
    year: 2025
    venue: arXiv 2507.04642
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.04642
    category: rl_for_ie
    role: direct_competitor
    key_finding: >
      首个将 RLVR（GRPO + verifiable reward）用于关系抽取的框架。
      将 RE 重构为推理任务，R1-RE-7B 在跨域 OOD 准确率约 70%，媲美 GPT-4o。
      Reward 设计：format reward (+1/-3) + metric reward (+2/-1.5)，先验证格式再加准确度。
      triplet extraction 用 F1-based reward（entity weight=1, triplet weight=3）。
      未报告 catastrophic forgetting——GRPO 训练后在 MATH-500/IFEval/GPQA 上性能不降反升，
      说明句子级 RE 的简单 reward 结构足以稳定 GRPO 训练。
    results:
      sem2010_in_domain: 91.8
      sem2010_ood: 66.5
      mdkg_in_domain: 88.1
      mdkg_ood: 65.8
    evidence_generation: false
    relevance_to_rsft_docre: >
      最直接竞争者。关键差异与讨论：
      (1) R1-RE 是句子级 RE，GRPO 成功；我们是文档级 RE，GRPO 失败→RSFT 成功。
      句子级 RE 每个 sample 只有 1 个 triple（binary classification），reward variance 天然充足；

1	\section{Related Work}
2	
3	\subsection{Document-Level Relation Extraction}
4	
5	Document-level relation extraction (DocRE) requires identifying relations between entity pairs scattered across multiple sentences, demanding cross-sentence reasoning over long contexts. Encoder-based methods have established strong baselines: DREEAM \cite{ma2023dreeam} guides attention with evidence supervision and self-training, while EIDER \cite{xie2022eider} fuses predictions from extracted evidence and the full document at inference time. CDER \cite{tran2025cder} captures collaborative patterns among semantically similar entity pairs via bipartite graphs, and EAAGRE \cite{eaagre2024} guides attention to evidence sentences without extra trainable parameters. These encoder methods, however, are limited to predefined relation schemas and cannot generalize to open-domain settings.
6	
7	Recent work has turned to LLMs for DocRE through two main paradigms. Pipeline approaches decompose the task into stages: LMRC \cite{li2024lmrc} uses a BERT classifier to filter non-relational pairs before LLM classification (Re-DocRED F1 74.63), and DocKS-RAG \cite{xu2025docksrag} augments LLM prompts with document-level knowledge graphs and sentence-level semantic retrieval. End-to-end generative methods instead produce triples directly: AutoRE \cite{autore2024} introduces a Relation-Head-Facts paradigm with QLoRA fine-tuning, while RelPrior \cite{relprior2025} prunes irrelevant entity pairs via binary relation priors (DocRED test F1 48.34). GLiDRE \cite{glidre2025} further extends the generative approach to zero/few-shot settings with a lightweight dual-encoder. Despite this progress, \citet{generative_ie_survey2024} identify structured output quality and efficiency as key open challenges for LLM-based IE.
8	
9	While these methods advance extraction accuracy, none jointly produces verifiable evidence sentences alongside relational triples in document-level RE. Ru-LLM \cite{ru_llm2025} constrains LLM outputs with logical rules mined from relational patterns, pursuing faithful generation through symbolic constraints rather than evidence grounding. FREIGE addresses this gap by formulating evidence-grounded DocRE as a unified generation task.
10	
11	\subsection{Evidence-Based Information Extraction}
12	
13	Evidence grounding has been explored primarily through encoder architectures in DocRE, with methods varying in how they incorporate evidence signals. One line of work addresses the scarcity of gold evidence annotations: DREEAM \cite{ma2023dreeam} pioneered self-training to generate silver evidence at scale, while COREX \cite{corex2024} jointly supervises two-hop reasoning and evidence prediction with adaptive focal loss. Another line focuses on architectural innovations for evidence-aware reasoning: GEGA \cite{mao2024gega} employs GCN with multi-weight matrices in a teacher-student framework, and Evidence-aware DocRE \cite{xu2022evidence_aware} models evidence selection as a sequential decision problem using reinforcement learning. KnowRA \cite{mai2025knowra} further integrates external knowledge retrieval and coreference-enhanced document knowledge graphs. These encoder-based methods treat evidence as an auxiliary training signal rather than a generative output, limiting their ability to provide verifiable provenance at inference time. Beyond DocRE, Grounded KG Extraction \cite{grounded_kg2025} provides character-level provenance tracking for each extracted triple.
14	
15	In the broader NLP landscape, the tension between faithfulness and task performance is well-documented. \citet{sprague2024mind_your_step} show that chain-of-thought can reduce performance by up to 36.3\% on certain tasks due to error accumulation. \citet{resck2024performance_explanation} formally explore the Pareto frontier between performance and explanation plausibility via multi-objective optimization. \citet{wallat2024correctness_faithfulness} demonstrate that correctness and faithfulness are independent dimensions, with up to 57\% of citations being post-rationalized. \citet{lyu2024faithful_survey} survey faithful explanations in NLP, identifying the faithfulness-performance trade-off as a core challenge. These findings motivate our framing of the ``evidence generation tax''---the cost in extraction accuracy incurred by requiring models to simultaneously produce supporting evidence.
16	
17	\subsection{Rejection Sampling and Reward-Based Fine-Tuning}
18	
19	Rejection sampling fine-tuning (RSFT) iteratively generates candidate responses, scores them with a reward function, and fine-tunes on the top-ranked outputs. RAFT \cite{raft2024} establishes the canonical framework: generate $n$ responses per prompt, rank by reward, and train on the top-$k$. \citet{xiao2025minimalist_rsft} show that this simple approach matches GRPO and PPO on mathematical reasoning, with GRPO's advantage stemming mainly from discarding all-wrong prompts rather than reward normalization. The theoretical connection to policy optimization is formalized by \citet{rsft_ppo2025}, who prove RSFT implicitly performs PPO with marginal KL constraints.
20	
21	Several extensions improve RSFT's sample efficiency. AdaSTaR \cite{chung2025adaptar} introduces diversity and curriculum sampling to address training imbalance, achieving SOTA with 58.6\% fewer FLOPs. TrajFusion \cite{deng2026trajfusion} interleaves failed and correct trajectories to model trial-and-error reasoning. RIFT \cite{rift2026} replaces hard rejection with soft reweighting of all trajectories by scalar reward, providing reverse gradients from negative samples. RS-DPO \cite{rsdpo2024} systematically combines rejection sampling with DPO by identifying contrastive pairs from the reward distribution.
22	
23	At inference time, Best-of-N (BoN) sampling applies the same generate-and-select principle without further training. \citet{huang2025bon_optimality} prove BoN provably suffers from reward hacking at large $N$ and propose InferenceTimePessimism for scaling-monotonic performance. \citet{chen2025inference_reward_hacking} show that the true reward first rises then falls under all inference-time mechanisms. Genie \cite{yehudai2024genie} demonstrates NLI-based filtering in a three-stage pipeline achieving human parity on content-grounded generation.
24	
25	FREIGE adopts RSFT with NLI-based scoring (CED) as its primary training strategy, and uses CED as an inference-time reranker---bridging RSFT and BoN paradigms while avoiding the decoupling pathology observed with online RL methods.
26	
27	\subsection{Reinforcement Learning for Structured Generation}
28	
29	Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has emerged as a prominent critic-free RL method for LLMs. DAPO \cite{dapo2025} addresses GRPO's entropy collapse via asymmetric clipping and dynamic sampling. Dr.\ GRPO \cite{dr_grpo2025} identifies difficulty and length biases from standard normalization. REINFORCE++ \cite{hu2025reinforcepp} proposes global batch normalization for more stable gradient estimation. In structured IE, R1-RE \cite{dai2025r1re} applies GRPO with verifiable rewards for cross-domain sentence-level RE, and R2GRPO \cite{li2025r2grpo} combines relevance and rule-mining rewards for scientific IE. E-GRPO \cite{egrpo2025} designs entity-aware rewards giving partial credit based on entity match rate. ReasoningNER \cite{reasoningner2025} uses a three-stage GRPO framework beating GPT-4 on zero-shot NER.
30	
31	However, applying RL to structured extraction tasks introduces pathologies not observed in reasoning benchmarks. \citet{jin2025rl_vs_sft} show RL fine-tuning cannot fully recover performance when SFT causes severe overfitting. EvidenceRL \cite{bentamo2026evidencerl}, a concurrent work applying RL to evidence-grounded generation in a different domain (clinical diagnosis), jointly optimizes evidence entailment and correctness via GRPO but does not report extraction-evidence decoupling. MO-GRPO \cite{ichihara2025mogrpo} and RDPO \cite{bai2026rdpo} address reward hacking in multi-objective settings, while \citet{wang2026reward_hacking_survey} propose the Proxy Compression Hypothesis explaining reward hacking as objective compression.
32	
33	A critical confound in RL for LLMs is quantization. QeRL \cite{qerl2025} shows standard quantization introduces deterministic noise harmful to RL exploration. \citet{quantization_rl_impact2025} find quantization-aware RL training actually harms learning, with post-training quantization performing better. \citet{shuttleworth2024lora_vs_fft} reveal LoRA and full fine-tuning produce structurally different weight matrices, with forgetting concentrated in ``intruder dimensions.'' Q-BLoRA \cite{seo2024qblora} identifies an imbalance between overly complex adapter I/O and insufficient trainability in quantized LLMs. CLoQ \cite{cloq2025} addresses quantization errors via calibrated LoRA initialization. These findings align with our observation that QLoRA amplifies the evidence-extraction decoupling from mild to catastrophic, acting not as the root cause but as a catastrophic amplifier of an inherent RL-for-IE pathology.
